item.description: Unverified content difference detected at https://mn.gov/boards/pharmacy/public/rulemaking.jsp on 2026-11-04T13:30:58+00:00. Compare the official source before assigning legal effect. Difference excerpt: --- previous +++ current @@ -1,18 +1,22 @@ skip to content Primary navigation -Proposed Rulemaking -The Board of Pharmacy is proposing revisions to state rules as outlined below. -The public comment period is now closed. +Rulemaking +Effective October 19, 2026, Minnesota Rules, part 6800.3400, subpart 1a took effect and permits the following information to be included on prescription drug labels: +Subp. 1a. +Additional labeling information. +After January 1, 2026, except for radiopharmaceuticals, all drugs dispensed to or for a patient, other than an inpatient of a hospital, may also be labeled with the following information: +A. the complete and unabbreviated generic name of the drug; and +B. instructions written in plain language explaining the patient-specific indications for the drug if the patient-specific indications are indicated on the prescription.
